worker.scope: New sequential software replay and actual ROS process only

prior_multirate_hold.scope: Complete nominal 30 s hold only; changed plant needs its own new full physical audit

software_qualification.historical_scope: Original mismatch inputs only; no old mismatch timing or flight result inherited
software_qualification.scope: Same accepted controller/runtime and timing; new .85/1.15 physical plant; no wrench, delay injection or hardware claim

physical_model.scope: Actual rigid mass/COM inertia mismatch against unchanged identified upper response; not an identified loaded-joint motor model

fault_supervision.scope: latest-value supervision; complete evidence is reconciled independently

worker.numerical_scope: Actual owning outputs checked against original wire; frozen independent software proofs separately reverified

optimizer_recovery.compact_capture_scope: Copied actual native centre/final nodes, extrema and integrated reference; full QP rows and model rollout are independently bound by software admission, not recaptured/reconstructed here

original_base_rows.scope: Compact dynamic count range and appended cut identities only; original full base matrix/zero-row omission remains bound by qualified assembly implementation

optimizer_interval.compact_capture_scope: Copied actual interval events and final native envelopes with independently recomputed sliding gradients and future-packet encoding kernels; full QP rows and native dense pieces remain bound by software admission, not recaptured or rerun here

actual_send_barrier.scope: Actual ActuatorSend CDR -> ingress kind5 -> next admission -> original worker callback

timing.physical_hold_clock: Original raw C++ source control_s at the tick source_sequence; same clock as candidate control_time_s
timing.writer_observation_scope: ActuatorSend.sim_s is a latest observed actuator state time, not physical time of publication

consumption.scope: physics-boundary adoption accounting; not motor ACK, bus-application or flight qualification
mapping_assumptions: initial legacy publications drained before the frozen send baseline
consumption.mapping_limit: Float64 has no wire identity; assumptions are not proven by counters alone.
consumption.lag_clock_note: Plugin adoption minus latest plugin observation at send; not wall transit latency.

online_ledger.stop_limit_scope: Existing release timeout is separate; the tracking progress watchdog stops after STOP.
online_ledger.scope: online observation/progress bookkeeping; status 2 is not an adoption acknowledgement

feedback.trajectory_scope: Frozen C2 fast: original world LiveStart centre, same original source time; no phase/position fitting
feedback.csv_visibility_limitation: The original source did not record per-poll CSV byte offsets. This audit reconstructs the prefix ending at the recorded selected joint row and last actual MIT packet. It proves original values and causal history, but does not prove that no newer complete row was file-visible at that poll.
feedback.offline_oracle_timing: Not a deployment deadline; no GC/deadline policy changed
feedback.scope: Original source selection/frames/actual-history/worker-input evidence; not full physical hold or safety certification

configuration.scope: Entire declared research stage; 20 s hover or 30 s joint probe; no omitted tail

reference_state_gate.ref_timestamp: not used as clock or equality gate; DDS may translate it

effective_parameters.source: ULog initial parameters plus every parameter change through window start; no after-restore substitution

configuration.constant_target_check_scope: Primary stationary-hover window only; appended steps are intentionally changing targets
configuration.step_received_target_audit: Separate from this guard; native response plus sent-target evidence alone does not certify PX4 received every step

px4_value_view.scope: Value-match observation lower-bound view: maximum of original raw source control observation and original writer actuator-state observation, both already held before the original wall send; not actual publication time or measured transport latency

handoff.scope: Original prestream PVA and actual bounded-causal received held values bridge startup; C++ starts at its separately reported first output/value observation
handoff.observation_scope: Value-match observation lower-bound view: maximum of original raw source control observation and original writer actuator-state observation, both already held before the original wall send; not actual publication time or measured transport latency

px4_commands.saturation_scope: Speed-bound check and internal/reconstructed residuals; no unsupported claim that every inner-loop actuator avoided saturation
px4_commands.time_alignment: Original pre-send known observation values only; no physical publication timestamp or fitted time shift
px4_commands.observation_scope: Value-match observation lower-bound view: maximum of original raw source control observation and original writer actuator-state observation, both already held before the original wall send; not actual publication time or measured transport latency

robustness_performance.scope: Rigid mismatch tracking is reported against original safety envelope; no new post-hoc precision threshold

scope: One fresh complete 24 s rigid-mismatch simulation; unchanged numerical backend/PID/reference/limits; execution separated from performance; observational PVA clock view is not publication timing or hardware qualification
